bull_bear.body:
- The company reports a net cash position: "Net Debt (period end)" of (143.3) crs standalone and (136.8) crs consolidated at Q1FY27, versus (124.7) and (116.8) at Q1FY26 (deck shows these in parentheses).
- Growth has been part-built through acquisitions: Goel Scientific Glass Works, Baroda (2008, entry into Process Systems) and Klasspack Pvt Ltd, Nasik (2018, entry into Pharma Primary Packaging).
- Shareholding as on 30th June 2026: Promoter & Promoter Group 68.27%, Public & Others 31.23%, DIIs 0.27%, FIIs 0.23%.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Borosil Scientific is considered as the GOLD standard in laboratory Glassware"; the deck claims "3 out of every 4 laboratory glassware products In India bear the Borosil Name".
- Founded in 1962 as a pioneer of borosilicate glassware in India and described as "the nation's most trusted laboratory solutions provider", serving pharmaceuticals, research, academia and industries.
- Readiness-to-WIN pillars listed as brand trust, diversified portfolio across Scientific Glassware / Lab Equipment / Process / Packaging, innovation edge (in-house R&D, NABL-accredited labs, automation-led manufacturing), pan-India distribution with 24-hour delivery capability, and deep institutional customer relationships.
- Part of the Borosil Group alongside Borosil Ltd (consumerware/kitchenware) and Borosil Renewables Ltd (solar glass); Borosil Scientific market cap stated at ~₹1,382 cr as on 30 July 2026 (NSE).
- Deck frames the company as "Embodiment of India's scientific self-reliance", noting the "Made in India Edge" and that innovation "is not only imported-it is built in India for the world".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Demerger] The Scientific Division was demerged from Borosil Ltd on 2nd Dec 2023 and listed as Borosil Scientific Limited on 7th June 2024.
- [Tariffs/exports] "US tariff reversal should propel the high-margin export business forward"; the deck also cites the global shift toward localized manufacturing and 'China Plus One' as positioning the company to capture significant share of opportunity.
- [Policy] "The launch of Biopharma SHAKTI in the Union Budget 2026-27 will pave the way for growth of our products in biologics and biosimilars."
- [Accounting] Lab Consumables revenue was "impacted during the period on account of Ind AS 115"; excluding that impact the deck states Lab Consumables growth of 7.4% and 14.6% across all product categories.
- [Group context] Group market caps as on 30 July 2026 (NSE): Borosil Renewables ₹7,882 cr, Borosil Ltd ₹2,820 cr, Borosil Scientific ₹1,382 cr - Borosil Renewables is described as India's first and largest solar glass manufacturer with combined capacity of 1000 TPD (~6.5GW), a group-company figure, not Borosil Scientific's.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Borosil Scientific as the "GOLD standard" in Indian laboratory glassware - a six-decade-old, demerged Borosil Group entity that has leveraged its brand to diversify from lab glassware and consumables into lab equipment, process systems and pharmaceutical primary packaging, and is targeting a 12-14% medium-term revenue CAGR.
